title: The water goes somewhere
hook: Which number describes water released by all items?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: Water leaving laundry enters the surroundings. This example multiplies retained water per item by the item count; it is a mass balance, not a forecast of room humidity.

misconception: The two pictured methods are interchangeable without checking their mechanism or constraints.

recall.question: Six towels each hold 300 g of water. If they dry completely indoors, how much water goes into the room?
recall.why: Water leaving laundry enters the surroundings: 6 × 300 g = 1800 g. This is a mass balance; it does not predict the room's humidity or any health outcome.
